hero.title: See what Intuit Enterprise Suite can do
hero.lede: Browse the capabilities that help growing finance teams close faster, consolidate cleaner, and scale without the legacy ERP overhead.
gallery.title: Explore by capability
gallery.subtitle: Pick a starting point. Every tile links to a deeper look at how it works.
item-1.title: Multi-Entity Consolidation
item-1.body: Manage entities, locations, and subsidiaries from a single sign-in with automatic intercompany eliminations.
item-2.title: AI Finance Agents
item-2.body: Automate bookkeeping and get a faster month-end close with the Accounting and Finance Agents.
item-3.title: Audit-Ready Controls
item-3.body: Custom roles, parallel approvals, and a complete transaction history keep your audit trail airtight.
item-4.title: QuickBooks & Legacy Migration
item-4.body: A dedicated team scopes, migrates, and onboards your data so you go live in days, not months.
item-5.title: Connected Ecosystem & Workforce
item-5.body: Native payroll and payments plus 850+ specialized apps in one open, connected platform.
item-6.title: Consolidated Dashboards
item-6.body: Roll up financials across your business into one real-time consolidated view without spreadsheets.
spotlight.title: Where most teams start
spotlight.body: Multi-entity consolidation delivers the fastest, most visible win: one sign-in, automatic eliminations, and consolidated reports across every entity you run.
